title: Hub signal bulletin reorganized: target-routed lifecycle replaces flat incoming dump
description: Hub Signals/incoming/ replaced with target-routed by-target/{hub,framework,spokes}/ structure. Signals must declare target on delivery. Lifecycle: arrive → triage → incorporate → teach → clear to processed/. 97 legacy signals triaged in initial sweep. Teaching distributed: signal-lifecycle-target-routing-v1.md.teaching.
rationale: 98 signals had accumulated with no routing, no clearing, no lifecycle. Spokes saw hub-internal signals. Already-implemented signals sat alongside actionable ones. Target routing + mandatory clearing prevents infinite accumulation.
